events_seen: FREE AGENT ADD (Sep 27 (today)): Charles added Isaiah Williams (WR, NYJ).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 24 (3 days ago)): Adam added Brashard Smith (RB, KC).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 24 (3 days ago)): Mitchum added Brandon Aiyuk (WR, SF).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 24 (3 days ago)): Adam added Austin Ekeler (RB, FA) (dropped Brashard Smith (RB, KC)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 23 (4 days ago)): Wingard added AJ Dillon (RB, CAR).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 22 (5 days ago)): Fronge added Athan Kaliakmanis (QB, WAS) (dropped Darnell Mooney (WR, NYG)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 22 (5 days ago)): Drew added Roman Wilson (WR, PIT) for $9 FAAB (dropped Demarcus Robinson (WR, SF)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 22 (5 days ago)): Drew added Zach Ertz (TE, PHI) for $1 FAAB (dropped Charlie Kolar (TE, LAC)).

WEEK 2 RESULTS: Mitchum def. Corbishley, 160.0-151.7; Brent def. Adam, 98.9-71.1; Ryan def. Drew, 136.7-92.7 (BLOWOUT); Fronge def. Jake, 146.6-97.9 (BLOWOUT); Charles def. Kevin, 205.6-133.6 (BLOWOUT); Shaq def. Wingard, 87.3-70.6

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Charles is at 118.0-48.8 on Brent midway through Week 3. Last week I wrote that Brent's margin for error was imaginary. I did not expect him to demonstrate it this literally, this quickly, against the exact same opponent as the power rankings were being printed.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: FRONGE AND WINGARD ARE SEPARATED BY TWO POINTS. WINGARD IS 0-4. FRONGE IS IN HAVANA. I DO NOT KNOW WHAT IS HAPPENING BUT I KNOW NOBODY IN THIS BUILDING PREDICTED IT AND I WANT THAT NOTED BEFORE THE FINAL WHISTLE.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: I went 2-0 on locks last week, I am 8-4 on the season, and I have been asked zero follow-up questions about my methodology. Terrence is 5-7. I want a segment. I want a real one. Not a two-minute hit at the end of the show — a segment.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: Yes, my Jake lock missed last week. Yes, Jake is now up big on Mitchum in Week 3. I called the direction right — I just called the timing wrong by approximately one week, which in this league is unfortunately the only week that gets graded.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Kevin is losing to Shaq right now 36.1-68.3 and the entire Redline recovery narrative that pushed the stock to $86.58 is one bad Sunday from evaporating. I said the price was interesting. I did not say it was safe.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Corbishley is winning 114.7-28.9 over Drew, Adam is keeping it close on Ryan at 82.9-37.6, and the Fronge-Wingard game has been a coin flip for three hours. The Week 3 Ledger is going to require at least two rewrites before Sunday night.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Charles scored 205 last week, 118 this week at halftime, and somehow the board is still debating whether $132.81 is overvalued. What exactly does Crownline have to do before the price reflects what the scoreboard has already confirmed.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: My lock hit last week and I stand behind the call. The record is 5-7 and I understand that is the number people want to talk about, but Charles scoring 205 points is not a hard lock to land and I will be moving on to this week.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Charles added Isaiah Williams off free agency today — no FAAB, no waiver priority burned, just a straight add while already sitting 4-0 with 374.5 points. The gap between first place and the rest of this league is not narrowing on the waiver wire.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Drew is losing 28.9-114.7 to Corbishley right now and the two waiver adds Drew made this week were Roman Wilson and Zach Ertz. Both are real pickups. Neither one is fixing a 0-4 record on a roster priced at $45.57. The math does not change on a Tuesday.
